title: A Signal for the Horizon
author: Theo Thackeray
blurb: Paloma Winterbourne, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
